top_signals.title: South Korea weighs fourth delay of crypto gains tax, eyes 2029 start: report
top_signals.summary: The delay reportedly aims to align with the U.S. schedule of integrating CARF, the OECD's international tax framework for digital assets.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.
